name: Filter — passenger type
description: Branches pass / fail. Pass when the passenger's type (ADT, CHD, INF, …) is one of the selected types. Pre-suggests choices from the ref-pax-types reference table.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The passenger-type field — pick from your request (e.g. paxType, ageCategory).

params.name: literal
params.description: Which passenger types should pass — type your own list, or use 'From Ref' to pick rows from the ref-pax-types reference table.

params.name: arraySelector
params.description: When the source resolves to multiple passengers (e.g. $.pax[*].paxType), which match decides pass/fail.

enum.label: Any match
enum.description: Pass if at least one pax matches (e.g. 'any adult').

enum.label: All match
enum.description: Pass only if every pax matches (e.g. 'all adults').

enum.label: None match
enum.description: Pass only when no pax matches (e.g. 'no infants').

enum.label: Only one
enum.description: Pass only when there is exactly one pax AND it satisfies the test.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the passenger has no type set.
